- store/memo.go, store/driver.go

The API handler additionally deletes comment memos first (server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:567-577).

**q17** — web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts (useMemos/useMemo/useCreateMemo/useUpdateMemo/useDeleteMemo, lines 112-258); client: `memoServiceClient` from web/src/connect.ts:197

Broadcasting handlers: `APIV1Service.CreateMemo` (memo_service.go:163), `DeleteMemo` (memo_service.go:585), `CreateMemoComment` (memo_service_comments.go:126), `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` from UpdateMemo (memo_update_helpers.go:71), `UpsertMemoReaction` (reaction_service.go:106), `DeleteMemoReaction` (reaction_service.go:161).

**q22** — dispatcher: `APIV1Service.DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` — server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:15, called from server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:157 (delegates to `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`, memo_service_webhooks.go:48, activity type `memos.memo.created`); delivery package: `internal/webhook` (`PostAsync` → worker pool → `Post`, internal/webhook/webhook.go:184, 120); signing: HMAC-SHA256 in the Standard Webhooks scheme — key from `whsec_<base64>` secret, MAC over `msgID.timestamp.body`, headers `webhook-id`/`webhook-timestamp`/`webhook-signature: v1,<sig>` (internal/webhook/webhook.go:133-150)

**q23**
- SQL schema: store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:33 (plus mysql/LATEST.sql:32, postgres/LATEST.sql:32)
- Go store model: store/memo.go:35 (`type Memo struct`)
- API proto message: proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto:198 (`message Memo`)
- Generated frontend types: web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts:79 (`export type Memo`)

**q24**
- web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts:178 (`useCreateMemo`, calls `createMemo` at line 183)
- web/src/connect.ts:197 (`memoServiceClient`)
- proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto:21 (`rpc CreateMemo`)
- server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70 (`APIV1Service.CreateMemo`)
- store/memo.go:109 (`Store.CreateMemo`)
- store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16 (`DB.CreateMemo`; `INSERT INTO memo …` at line 41)

**q25** — Engine: CEL (google/cel-go) wrapped by the in-repo filter engine — internal/filter/engine.go:14-71 (`Engine.Compile` compiles CEL to a dialect-agnostic `Condition` tree; schema/env in internal/filter/schema.go, expression lowering in internal/filter/parser.go). Mechanism: the compiled condition tree is rendered to a dialect-specific SQL fragment plus args by `Program.Render`/`CompileToStatement` with `RenderOptions{Dialect: …}` (internal/filter/engine.go:74-99, internal/filter/render.go), and each driver injects it into its WHERE clause via `filter.AppendConditions(…, filter.DialectSQLite|DialectMySQL|DialectPostgres, &where, &args)` (store/db/sqlite/memo.go:57-61, store/db/mysql/memo.go:65-69, store/db/postgres/memo.go:54-58; dialect constants internal/filter/schema.go:14-16).

**q26** — `memo` (store/db/sqlite/memo.go:239), `memo_relation` (explicit cascade, store/memo.go:142-146), `attachment` (explicit cascade, store/memo.go:149-157), `memo_share` (DB-level `ON DELETE CASCADE`, store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:109, mysql/LATEST.sql:108, postgres/LATEST.sql:108). Note: `reaction` rows are only *read* during DeleteMemo (server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:545) — no delete, no FK cascade on that table.

**q27** — The built `dist/` bundle is compiled into the Go binary with `//go:embed dist/*` and served by Echo's static middleware plus an SPA fallback — server/router/frontend/frontend.go:20-21 (embed), 41-61 (`Serve`: `middleware.StaticWithConfig` + `spaFallbackMiddleware`); wired into the server at server/server.go:72.

**q28**
- `s3presign.Runner` — one immediate `RunOnce` at startup, then a `time.Ticker` every 12 hours (server/server.go:162-171; interval server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27-41). It is the only runner started (`startBackgroundRunners`, server/server.go:153-174).
- Unused infrastructure: `internal/scheduler` (cron-style scheduler, internal/scheduler/scheduler.go) is never used by the server — `scheduler.New` has zero callers (certified zero); references exist only in its own docs/tests (internal/scheduler/doc.go, example_test.go). Also `server/runner/memopayload.Runner` is never instantiated — `memopayload.NewRunner` has zero callers (certified zero); only its `RebuildMemoPayload` helper is called inline from the memo handlers (server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108, 447).

**q29** — Interceptor: `authInterceptor` in web/src/connect.ts:156-178 (installed on the transport at line 188). Tokens it manages: a short-lived JWT access token sent as `Authorization: Bearer …` (state in web/src/auth-state.ts, refreshed proactively when expiring and reactively on `Unauthenticated`, connect.ts:124-150, 164-176) and an httpOnly refresh-token cookie used by `AuthService.RefreshToken` over a separate interceptor-free transport (connect.ts:57-83). Backend validation package: `server/auth` (server/auth/authenticator.go — `AuthenticateByAccessTokenV2` line 41, `AuthenticateByRefreshToken` line 61, `AuthenticateByPAT` line 102 for personal access tokens; token parsing in server/auth/token.go), invoked from server/router/api/v1/v1.go:66-93 (gateway) and the Connect auth interceptor (v1.go:137).

**q30**
- memo created: `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` — server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:15 (called memo_service.go:157)
- memo updated: `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` — memo_service_webhooks.go:20 (called memo_update_helpers.go:67)
- memo deleted: `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` — memo_service_webhooks.go:25 (called memo_service.go:562)
- comment created: `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` — memo_service_webhooks.go:30 (called memo_service_comments.go:119)

The first three converge on `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (memo_service_webhooks.go:48); all four then converge on `webhook.PostAsync` → `webhook.Post` — internal/webhook/webhook.go:184 and :120.
